title: Neutron imaging to study the influence of flow fields and porous electrodes on concentration distributions in redox flow cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5278-5289
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00844A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maxime van der Heijden, Rémy Richard Jacquemond, Emre Burak Boz, Pierre Boillat, Antoni Forner-Cuenca
This study uses operando neutron imaging and electrochemical data to reveal how flow field geometry and electrode structure shape concentration profiles and transport dynamics in organic redox flow cells.
